name: Being A Witness
overview: Scripture calls believers to be faithful witnesses of God's truth, empowered by the Holy Spirit to proclaim Christ to all nations, as emphasized in Acts 1:8 and Matthew 28:19. Being a witness involves living visibly for Christ, letting our good works shine before others to glorify the Father (Matthew 5:15-16). God declares His people as His chosen witnesses to affirm His unique deity and redeeming purpose (Isaiah 43:10), while Proverbs 14:25 highlights the vital role of truthful testimony in delivering souls from deception.
